## About our Lexington, KY PetSmart Grooming Salon

Our Pet Stylists take care of dogs and cats across Lexington, helping them look and feel their best. Our Pet Stylists are academy-trained with over 800 hours of hands-on experience, ready for any bath, full groom, or haircut your dog or cat needs. Your pet's skin and coat are soothed and improved with specially formulated shampoos and conditioners, and a de-shedding treatment helps tackle flying fur and matted coats alike. Our salon off Paul Jones Way at Hamburg Pavilion is a reliable stop for dog grooming in Lexington, and we welcome walk-ins for nail grinds and other quick services alongside Seasonal Specials and complete spa packages. Before you head out, ask our Pet Stylists about products that will help your dog or cat stay fresh until the next visit. Every groom benefits from our Pet Stylists getting to know your pet along the way.
